Patterns under application

Every shipped pattern (patterns/*.html), rendered with this situation's tokens and base.css. Generated by @sax/design-system v1.0.3.

button

Actions. Bare

field

Labelled form control, one per block. Label typography comes from base.css; works unchanged for input, select, and textarea.

card

Bordered surface container for any flow content. Cards are flat — border on surface, never a shadow.

Risk controls

Position limits and drawdown budgets are enforced inside the optimizer, not applied after the fact.

alert

System-generated transient status on live pages. Variants: success, warning, danger. Authored admonitions in documentation use the callout pattern instead.

tag

Topic or metadata pill, inline with text or in a meta row. Not interactive by itself; wrap in when it filters or navigates.

callout

are accepted for rendered markdown. Variants: note, tip, important, warning, caution.

Note

Vendor restatements change history; cite the content address in published results.

Tip

Pin the data snapshot in the run manifest to make reruns byte-for-byte identical.

Important

Timestamps resolve against the content address, not the vendor feed.

Warning

A strategy hash mismatch invalidates every downstream attribution table.

Caution

Deleting a snapshot is irreversible and breaks reproduction of any run that cites it.

page-shell-application

Every application page starts here. Regions: app bar (brand + toolbar), sidebar, full-bleed main, status footer. The slot markers (slot:name) are the prototype build's assembly anchors — keep them when copying.
